sources.title: Cristiano Ronaldo announces his international retirement from Portugal
sources.quote_checked: To the Portuguese people, the day has come for me to hand back the No. 7 shirt of our national team. | it was not an easy decision because some decisions are not made with the mind alone. They are also made with the heart.

sources.title: 'I don't need to prove anything' - Ronaldo talks Trump, GOAT debate and World Cup hopes
sources.quote_checked: People say: 'Cristiano will be the greatest if he wins the World Cup.' I don't agree. | none of that will change my name in the history of football. The history speaks for itself. | I've learnt by now that the moment is the most important thing we have.

sources.title: Like a force
sources.quote_checked: Talent without work is nothing and work without talent is nothing. They have to work together. I have both. | Discipline is the main thing. | Of course I don't like going to the gym every day, nobody does, but you have to.

sources.title: Cristiano Ronaldo has not lost his self-regard in latest interview
sources.quote_checked: In the world, no one is more famous than me. | I'm not normal. I'm perfect.

sources.title: Talent is not enough - Cristiano Ronaldo on the secret to his success
sources.quote_checked: I think my biggest strength is my mind. Talent is not enough anymore.
